scope: Audit only the operation-specific NPI One to ERPNext Tool Asset execution boundary allocated to P8-05 for INT-005 and FR-TL-011 through FR-TL-016.

Inspect the exact physical Tooling Set, Tooling Master and accepted revision truth, existing Phase 6 tooling, manufacturing, engineering-control, acceptance, movement, repair, spare and read-only ERP Asset projection foundations, P8-03 and P8-04 operation-specific execution peers, ownership contracts, permissions, idempotency, migration and rollback before choosing any implementation.
